messages:
Tony - Helix Commerce: Hey team — we're ready to onboard our "HelixSearch" re-ranking model. It's domain-tuned on retail purchase histories and includes some PII (emails, order ids). Need help with safety/PHI handling, test evals, and a rollout plan. Can we get a checklist? /cc @Alex (CS)

Alex (CS): Thanks Tony — welcome! Quick q's: 1) datasets (size & PHI types) 2) expected qps and latency SLO 3) allowed persistence of logs/KV cache 4) timeline for go-live? Can you paste a sample prompt + anonymized example?

Tony - Helix Commerce: Dataset ~200k conversations, PII = emails, partial order IDs, shipping addresses. Target QPS 50 with <200ms p50. Timeline: pilot in 3 weeks. Sample prompt: "Given order 12345, summarize return eligibility..." (will anonymize) :raising_hand:

Alex (CS): Got it. @Maria (SE) can you weigh in on private vs dedicated and token retention? Also we may need Eval suite: utility (accuracy), hallucination rate, PII leakage checks.

Maria (SE): Short answer: Dedicated or Private recommended because of PHI/addresses. We can set KV caching disabled for this customer, enable request-level encryption, and scrub order ids with regex before logging. Perf-wise 50 qps @200ms p50 -> needs 1-2 x A100 equivalent in Dedicated; we can propose autoscale. We'll prepare runbook + quantization recommendations. @Casey (CSM) can you handle training + SOW?

Casey (CSM): Yup. I'll coordinate enablement + renewal implications. Quick question: is Helix comfortable with a canary rollout and manual approval gating? Also need to capture success metrics for renewal (reduction in support tickets, CTR uplifts).

Tony - Helix Commerce: Canary = fine. We care about false positives in eligibility (should be <2%) and no PII leaks. Also need SOC2/HIPAA addendum — legal is already pinged.

safety-bot: safety-checklist: Please ensure you run "pii-leakage-scan v2" and "adversarial-prompt-test". See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/safety/checklists/model-onboard

Alex (CS): We'll add those to evals. Tony, can you share sample anonymized transcripts in S3 (read-only) and grant redwood-devex@redwood.com access? Also want to schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow 10am PT — works?

Tony - Helix Commerce: Granting access now. 10am PT works. Also can we mask emails with placeholder token? We'll push anonymized files by EOD.

Maria (SE): For the eval harness, we'll run: 1) accuracy on labeled testset 2) leakage tests 3) latency under load. I'll post a small config snippet for the harness:
```json
{
  "qps": 50,
  "p50_latency_ms": 200,
  "leakage_scan": true
}
```

Alex (CS): Perfect. I'll create the onboarding ticket and tag SRE + Legal. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Tony - Helix Commerce: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the kickoff."
